programmes.d: The Doctor comes face-to-face with the might of the War Machines.
The Doctor hatches a dangerous plan.
(1/4) The travelers find themselves below the Earth's surface in the lost city of Atlantis.
A mysterious traveler can visit any point in space and time.
A mysterious traveler can visit any point in space and time.
(4/4) Zaroff's insane scheme to destroy the world nears completion.
The Doctor discovers archaeologists trying to find the lost tombs of the Cybermen.
The Doctor and archaeologists discover the city of Telos isn't as dead as they assumed.
Trapped in the tombs, the Cybermen release their poisonous pets, Cybermats.
How will the Doctor rid Telos of Cybermen once and for all?
The Doctor discovers that he has arrived on Earth the year 2017 A.D. and that he is the exact double of a would-be dictator called Salamander.
The Doctor is informed by Astrid's boss, Kent, that the world is on the verge of domination by a charismatic scientist and politician named Salamander.
The Doctor impersonates his lookalike, would-be dictator Salamander, to penetrate a research station controlled by Salamander's minions.
Giles Kent is revealed to be a traitor, in league with would-be 21st century dictator Salamander; the Doctor infiltrates the dictator's research station.
Traitorous scientist Kent has blown up the research station infiltrated by the Doctor; not long afterward, Salamander, who bears a startling resemblance to the Doctor, makes an appearance.
Having been thwarted in his plans to rule the world, Salamander tries to make a quick getaway by posing as the Doctor. Manning the controls of the TARDIS, Salamander tries to escape.
(1/5) The Dominators plan to enslave and exploit the natives of peaceful planet Dulkis.
(2/5) The Doctor and Jamie are forced to undergo a series of Dominator tests.
(3/5) Dissension in the Dominator ranks, as Rago and Toba clash over command of the Quarks.
(4/5) Jamie and Cully become trapped in an underground shelter and the air is running out.
(5/5) The Doctor has figured out the Dominators plan, but is it too late to stop them?
The Doctor is forced to use the emergency unit, removing them from time space dimension!
Zoe, Jamie and the Doctor are transported to a puzzling world where they are confronted by riddles.
The Doctor and his companions are apparently being tested, but by whom and why?
The Doctor and Zoe have to fight the fabled Medusa and a 21st Century comic strip creation.
The Doctor attempts to save his companions but instead finds himself imprisoned.
The Doctor learns of the discovery of two alien seed pods in the Antarctic.
The Krynoid is on the loose in the Arctic.
The Doctor and Sarah track down the remaining Krynoid pod.
Keeler has been infected by the alien pod and is transforming into a Krynoid.
The Krynoid demands that the Doctor be surrendered to it.
The Doctor, Sarah and Scorby are hunted down by the mad Harrison Chase.
The TARDIS arrives in no man's land during World War I.
The Doctor, Jamie and Zoe make their escape in Lady Jennifer's ambulance.
The Doctor discovers that they are on a planet where soldiers fight never ending wars.
The Doctor and Zoe penetrate the Aliens' HQ.
In the American Civil War zone, Jamie and Lady Jennifer join forces.
The Doctor sends Zoe to the war zones to assemble a resistance force.
The Doctor, Jamie and Carstairs have escaped back to the 1917 war zone.
The Doctor is captured by the War Chief.
